questions.question: Name three persuasive techniques and explain how each works.
questions.correctAnswer: Rhetorical questions (make reader think), emotive language (evoke feelings), statistics (add credibility) - plus many other valid techniques.

questions.question: Why is it important to address counter-arguments in persuasive writing?
questions.correctAnswer: It shows you've considered different viewpoints and strengthens your argument by preemptively refuting opposition.

questions.question: Write an opening paragraph persuading your school to introduce a healthy eating policy.
questions.correctAnswer: Your paragraph should include: clear viewpoint, rhetorical question or hook, and persuasive techniques.
